svg.aria-label: A rising tone climbs the frequency axis over three seconds
svg.title: A rising tone climbs the frequency axis over three seconds
svg.desc: Spectrogram: a time-by-frequency heatmap of a short-time Fourier transform. A bright diagonal sweeps from low to high frequency (a rising tone), a solid band at the base is a steady bass drone, and three vertical streaks are percussive taps. Colour runs dark purple (quiet) to yellow (loud).
svg.text: A rising tone climbs the frequency axis over three seconds
Short-time Fourier transform of a synthesised clip — brighter = louder · Illustrative data
